{{Top}}
'''Balc''' was a language used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used an [[Dark illusion/Legends|incantation]] in Balc around the time [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was fighting against the spirit of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]], with the words uttered being ''Kintik hadzuska sutta chwituskak! Kintik hadzuska sutta chwituskak! Jiaasjen Jidai, jiassjen Jidai!''.

==Behind the scenes==
The phrase in "Balc speech" are in fact words in [[Sith (language)|Sith]] as developed by [[Ben Grossblatt]] for ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''. They do not, however, translate into a meaningful sentence, as it would literally translate as "Blackest born flung spears! Blackest born flung spears! Integrating the shadow Jedi, integrating the shadow Jedi!"
